findings.finding: Crisis education must never continue as an exercise or depend on unverified resources.
findings.action: Urgent routes now stop content, require human help, and withhold unverified resources.

findings.finding: Relationship skills could be misapplied to violence, coercion, or retaliation.
findings.action: Safety gates precede dialogue; no-contact, support, and no-confrontation routes are explicit.

findings.finding: Burnout, warning signs, and patterns could become self-diagnosis.
findings.action: All are explicitly non-diagnostic with persistence, severity, impairment, and danger thresholds.

findings.finding: One hundred days could become coercive workload, backlog, or streak dependence.
findings.action: Minimum, rest, missed-day, no-debt, and exit rules are explicit and system-specified.

findings.finding: Repeated headings could hide duplicated generic content and weak transfer.
findings.action: Automated uniqueness checks pass and every integration day uses novel cases and prerequisite retrieval.

findings.finding: Completion could be mistaken for effectiveness.
findings.action: Evaluation separates comprehension, attempts, null/negative effects, access, and attrition; no wellbeing score exists.

findings.finding: Global evidence and generic Arabic cannot establish Egyptian cultural fit or safe local resources.
findings.action: Egyptian examples and structural constraints are explicit; direct user/language and resource validation remain a publication hold.

findings.finding: Family, religion, gender, class, work, and law could be treated as homogeneous.
findings.action: Plural frames, power questions, optional spiritual routes, and no fixed family/gender assumptions are specified.

findings.finding: Journals, AI, and relationship content could expose sensitive data or people on shared devices.
findings.action: No-storage defaults, per-use AI consent, forbidden sinks, shared-device routes, and deletion/export contracts exist.

findings.finding: Forty-four fields and media could overload cognition, network, and assistive technology.
findings.action: Presentation grouping, one primary practice, minimum mode, semantic RTL, text-first and offline failure rules exist.

findings.finding: Search and pattern libraries could diagnose or profile vulnerability.
findings.action: Search forbids diagnostic ranking, stores no query by default, and starts unknown mode with safety and non-diagnostic routing.

findings.finding: Financial, work, civic, medical, and legal content could drift beyond scope.
findings.action: Scope boundaries, high-risk exclusions, expert thresholds, and structural constraints are explicit.

requiredExternalDecisions: pilot ethics, users, negative outcomes, and effectiveness
